messages:
ana-partnerships: FYI — EdgeScale told us they want to change appliance reporting from hourly to per-minute granularity. They're asking for a migration window and a reconciliation plan.

sam-engineering: rough question — do they want a new event schema or just a different unit on the existing `usage_minutes` field?

ana-partnerships: they propose a new `usage_seconds` field and to stop sending hourly aggregates. sample payload below they provided.

ana-partnerships: ```json
{
  "device_id": "edge-1234",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T14:12:00Z",
  "usage_seconds": 120,
  "sku_id": "redwood.edge.small"
}
```

sam-engineering: ok — ingestion will need a small parser change + conversion into our canonical `usage_minutes` (or switch to seconds internally). Backfill plan: 1) accept both schemas for 30 days, 2) run backfill job for last 90 days if partner requests. Estimate: 2 dev days + 1 day for backfill infra.

jess-devex: we need a partner sandbox with replay capability and example golden-files so partners can test producer behavior. also, add a test verifying idempotency keys so duplicate per-second events don't double bill.

katie-sre: :eyes: also recommend a per-partner ingestion rate limiter and a monitoring dashboard (p95 event ingestion latency, duplicate rate). If we backfill, we should throttle the backfill job to avoid downstream overload.

marc-legal: quick flag — changing billing unit from hourly -> per-minute or per-second can affect revenue recognition and customer T&Cs. We need an amendment that clarifies proration, effective date, and a 30-day notice period. I'll draft language once we lock dates.

ana-partnerships: thanks. partner asked for migration window starting 2026-04-05 and wants to stop hourly exports by 2026-04-12. That gives us ~2 weeks to validate. Thoughts?

sam-engineering: short window but doable if we parallelize: schema support + sandbox + basic backfill dry-run. We'll need a small feature flag and a canary. Can we limit initial rollout to 10 devices?

jess-devex: yes, limit to test tenant + canary devices. i'll prepare onboarding doc and sample golden-files.

partners-bot: ACTION_CREATED: onboarding-ticket #PRT-1842 created and assigned to sam-engineering. Checklist items: schema-support, sandbox, backfill-plan, billing-sig, legal-approval.

ana-partnerships: action items — (1) sam scope + estimate today, (2) jess create sandbox + docs by EOD tomorrow, (3) marc draft amendment by Fri, (4) katie add monitoring alerts and rate limits. I'll coordinate partner comms once we have signoffs.

sam-engineering: I'll post a short deployment plan later today. For the backfill, propose using our hourly->minute conversion heuristics: if partner provides per-minute aggregates we prefer them; for per-second raw events we'll aggregate server-side into minute buckets. Example mapping CSV we'll add to docs:

```
partner_sku,redwood_sku,unit,notes
edge-small,redwood.edge.small,seconds,convert to minutes for billing by rounding up
edge-pro,redwood.edge.pro,seconds,apply partner discount mapping
```

jess-devex: adding a sample replay command for partner to validate payloads:

```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/partners/ingest \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d @edgesample.json
```

katie-sre: quick ops note — include `idempotency_key` in event schema. If absent, we generate one at ingress but flag those events in logs so reconciliation knows they were synthesized.

marc-legal: ping when you have exact effective date in the ticket so I can reference it in the amendment. Also, preserve an audit trail of replaced invoices if any customers are impacted.

ana-partnerships: great. I'll update partner with tentative dates and request sample data for last 30 days. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
